chapter.heading: Coming with Authority
chapter.v:
This will
be the third time I am coming to you. “By the mouth of two or three witnesses every word shall be established.” [[Matt. 5:48];]

I have
told you before, and foretell as if I were present the second time, and now being absent I write to those who have sinned before, and to all the rest, that if I come again I will not spare—

since you
seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, who is not weak toward you, but mighty in you. [Col. 3:5-7 g [Luke 12:15]] [Matt. 12:34, 35; Eph. 4:29;]

For though
He was crucified in weakness, yet He lives by the power of God. For we also are weak in Him, but we shall live with Him by the power of God toward you.

Examine yourselves
as to whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Do you not know yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

But I
trust that you will know that we are not disqualified.Paul Prefers Gentleness

Now I
pray to God that you do no evil, not that we should appear approved, but that you should do what is honorable, though we may seem disqualified. [1 Tim. 5:22]

For we
can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth. [1 Thess. 5:5]

For we
are glad when we are weak and you are strong. And this also we pray, that you may be made complete. [Gal. 5:22 2 NU]

Therefore I
write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the authority which the Lord has given me for edification and not for destruction.Greetings and Benediction [[Rom. 12:1, 2]]

Finally, brethren,
farewell. Become complete. Be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace will be with you. [1 Cor. 5:9;]

Greet one
another with a holy kiss. [Rom. 1:24]

The grace
of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen. [[Is. 26:19;]
